declarations.description: Enhances the first light-DOM table with header buttons, localized descriptions, aria-sort, numeric/text keys, and row grouping. Configure labels before initialization. Header contents are replaced with their text; sorting moves original rows into new bodies and preserves effective group keys, not arbitrary tbody attributes. Disconnecting cancels pending initialization and removes button listeners. Shared indicator and hidden-description styles target the default table-sortable tag.
declarations.name: TableSortableElement

members.name: labelSortable
members.description: Reflects label-sortable. Missing or empty values use the English default. Configure before initialization; later reflection does not update rendered descriptions.

members.name: labelAscending
members.description: Reflects label-ascending. Missing or empty values use the English default. Configure before initialization.

members.name: labelDescending
members.description: Reflects label-descending. Missing or empty values use the English default. Configure before initialization.

events.name: table-sortable:sort
events.description: Fired when a column is sorted

attributes.name: label-sortable
attributes.description: Accessible description for an unsorted column button (default: 'Click to sort ascending'). Each button references the shared description with aria-describedby.

attributes.name: label-ascending
attributes.description: Accessible description for the ascending sort state (default: 'sorted ascending. Click to sort descending').

attributes.name: label-descending
attributes.description: Accessible description for the descending sort state (default: 'sorted descending. Click to sort ascending').

cssProperties.name: --table-sortable-indicator-asc
cssProperties.description: Ascending sort indicator character or symbol (default: ↑)

cssProperties.name: --table-sortable-indicator-desc
cssProperties.description: Descending sort indicator character or symbol (default: ↓)

cssProperties.name: --sort-indicator-asc
cssProperties.description: Legacy ascending fallback when --table-sortable-indicator-asc is unset (default: ↑)

cssProperties.name: --sort-indicator-desc
cssProperties.description: Legacy descending fallback when --table-sortable-indicator-desc is unset (default: ↓)

declarations.name: defineTableSortable
declarations.description: Importing this module automatically calls the helper with the default tag. Returns false without a usable browser registry; otherwise defines the requested tag if absent and returns true. Repeated calls for the same tag are safe. Use the class-only import to control registration timing.
